plugins.photosPermission: Gather uses your photos when you attach an image to a post.
plugins.cameraPermission: Gather uses your camera when you take photos, record videos, or go live.
plugins.microphonePermission: Gather uses your microphone when you record videos with sound or join a live broadcast.

plugins.contactsPermission: Gather uses your phone contacts only after you opt in, so you can select email addresses to find friends. No invitations are sent automatically.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Gather uses your current location only when you choose to share it with selected Gatherings.
